title: A worker supervisor
description:
Restart worker processes that crash, waiting longer each time, and give up eventually.

```
worker 1 crashed (exit 0xC0000005) -> restart in 1 s
worker 1 crashed -> restart in 2 s
worker 1 crashed -> restart in 4 s
worker 1 crashed 4 times in a minute -> giving up, reporting
worker 2 exited normally -> not restarted
```
hints: Keep each worker's recent crash times and drop those older than 60 s before counting (lesson 6.02).
requirements: Feed events `(time, worker, exitCode)` to a `Supervisor`.
Exit code 0 ends the worker; anything else restarts it with doubling delays (1, 2, 4 ... max 30 s).
More than 3 crashes within 60 s stops restarting that worker.
stretch: Reset the delay once a worker has run for 5 minutes without crashing.
